findings.text: Guest transition helper for outer guest loop with interrupts enabled checks current thread work flags and returns idle when no guest work present, otherwise drains work in inner loop until flags clear.

Inner guest work drain treats pending signal related flags as interrupt request, invokes scheduler for reschedule related flags, invokes user mode resume work for resume flag, then delegates remaining flags to architecture handler and re-reads flags.
Personality system call returns prior task personality and only updates stored personality when argument differs from all bits set sentinel.

Execdomains proc entry reports one fixed Linux domain line tagged as kernel, oops limit sysctl under kernel exposes writable unsigned value defaulting to ten thousand, and oops count sysfs file emits decimal counter value.
Task execution state object carries reference count, dumpability marker and user namespace reference, allocated from dedicated slab cache created at init with aligned accountable storage.

Execution state lifetime starts with count one and non dumpable default, copy for new task allocates fresh object sharing source user namespace and copies dumpability snapshot then publishes with RCU assignment, while final reference drop schedules RCU callback that releases namespace and returns memory to cache.

Execution state read uses RCU protection or allocator lock, dumpability query uses RCU guard plus one time read, and replacement requires both allocator lock and exclusive execution update lock before exchanging pointer with RCU semantics.
Release staging object holds one pid pointer per pid type for batched freeing after locks are released.

Pid pointer mutation requires exclusive task list lock, single type pointer selection distinguishes thread pid from shared signal pid array, detach clears requested link and only stages old pid when no type still references it.

Process unhash decrements global thread count, detaches thread pid and wakes pid descriptor waiters, and for dead thread group additionally detaches group process group and session pids and removes global and sibling links plus per CPU process count.

Thread signal exit serializes on signal handler lock, handles POSIX timer exit and group versus non group paths including notification count wake and current target advance and tty detach, then accumulates CPU times faults context switches IO counters and scheduler runtime into shared signal structure while holding statistics sequence lock and unhashing.

After statistics update the exiting thread publishes null signal handler pointer with release ordering before unlocking, then drops handler reference freeing only on last reference with signal file cleanup, and drops tty reference for dead group.

Task release performs limit accounting and subsystem release, pins thread pid before unhash, takes exclusive task list lock for ptrace and signal exit with possible notification for last non leader when leader already zombie, then flushes proc pid, exits credential namespaces, mixes scheduler runtime into randomness pool, frees staged pids, releases architecture thread state, flushes shared signal queue for group leader, drops RCU user reference and repeats for auto reaped leader.
Delayed task structure drop flushes probe rethook perf and trace state before final reference drop, and RCU user drop schedules that callback only when user count reaches zero.
Credential namespace exit drops active reference on user namespace taken from real credentials.

Pid freeing asserts task list lock is not held, drops active namespace reference, then under pid map lock decrements allocation counts waking namespace reaper when few identifiers remain, removes each level identifier, then removes file system entry and defers final drop through RCU.

Signal queue flush clears pending mask and frees every queued entry with list unlink and per entry release; group leader release invokes it lockless for shared queue after unhash when no other accessor remains.

Parent notification validates signal, asserts non stopped and empty or traced state, notifies pid descriptor waiters, coerces non child signal to child signal when parent execution identity changed, then builds status info with namespace scoped pid and munged uid plus combined CPU times and decoded exit versus killed versus dumped outcome.

Parent notification honors ignored child disposition or no wait flag and per task auto reap flag to suppress signal and request immediate reaping, otherwise sends signal into parent thread group and wakes parent child exit wait queue under parent signal lock.
Pid descriptor notification wakes normal waiters with readable poll events and expects task already exiting.
RCU waiter wake takes RCU read section with full barrier pairing publisher condition against waiter publication before dereferencing waiter task and waking it if present.

Orphaned group test scans group members skipping ignored exiting empty and init reparented tasks and reports orphaned unless a member has parent outside group but inside same session; current group query wraps test in shared task list lock.

Exit or reparent path sends hangup followed by continue with privileged origin when parent and child groups differ within same session and surviving group is orphaned with stopped jobs; stopped job test scans group for stop flag.
Process group signal broadcast iterates group members through group send helper and reports success if any delivery succeeds, otherwise last error or missing group.
Group signal send checks permission under RCU read section before actual delivery, skipping delivery entirely when signal number is zero.

Kill permission rejects invalid signal numbers, allows kernel originated signals without further checks, otherwise invokes audit then credential comparison of real and effective user identities against target real and saved identities or kill capability in target user namespace, with same session allowance for continue, then defers to security hook.

Core dump exit participation enqueues signaled tasks onto dumper list with atomic last thread completion, then parks non participant idle and participants in freezable idle schedule loop until finished, finally restoring running state.

Memory owner reassignment scans thread group for mapping match, and on match takes task lock to revalidate mapping then releases task list read lock before publishing new owner and migrating management state.

Signal handler pointer clearing needs release visibility for lockless observers, staged pid array must reject duplicate staging, and thread pid must be pinned before unhash to avoid early free before proc flush.

Interfaces exposed by these fragments include guest mode work handling, execution state allocation reference and dumpability access, task and RCU user reference drops, pid detach and free, signal queue flush, parent and pid descriptor notification, waiter wake, orphaned group query, group signal broadcast, and credential namespace exit.
